personalProjects.title: NAO Aeronautics
personalProjects.summary: Founded a logistics startup concept to bring city resources to remote areas.
personalProjects.details: Developed a full business plan, process architecture, and prototype. Conducted 35 outreach contacts and interviewed 15 professionals across mining, cattle raising, farming, defense, NGOs, social programs, and expeditions to identify customers, early adopters, and iterate on the product.
personalProjects.architectureExplanation: Process architecture and prototype defined as part of the venture planning and iteration.

personalProjects.title: VCOW
personalProjects.summary: Pivoted from vertical farming for cattle-raising into a crowdfunding platform for cattle projects.
personalProjects.details: Developed for the CREATE-X course (Georgia Tech). Interviewed 40+ cattle farmers to understand needs, then after pivot interviewed 10+ people to understand investment strategies and refine customer base.
personalProjects.architectureExplanation: Business model pivot guided by interview-driven validation; platform concept defined around crowdfunding workflows.

workProjects.title: Employee Absence Management Software
workProjects.summary: Web application enabling employers to manage employee absences.
workProjects.details: Defined and documented requirements, designed the architecture and database, and built backend microservices and database layers.
workProjects.architectureExplanation: Monolith architecture using Next.js + GraphQL backed by PostgreSQL/Supabase, with backend services and database layers built to support absence workflows.

workProjects.title: Lookup
workProjects.summary: Multi-brand clothing catalog with CSV inventory upload and store/product geolocation.
workProjects.details: Collaboration with business students. Defined and documented requirements, designed the architecture and database, and developed backend microservices along with the database.
workProjects.architectureExplanation: REST microservice architecture with services split across Spring Boot and NestJS; React (Vite) frontend; MongoDB as the database engine.
